title: University of Valley Forge closing after 87 years
summary: The private Christian university in Phoenixville will suspend academic operations at the end of its Summer 2026 semester, ending an 87-year run. Trustees cited years of financial strain and an accreditation warning, and the school is helping students transfer.

title: Ocean State Job Lot nears opening at Shoppes at Valley Forge
summary: The discount chain is filling out a 29,525-square-foot former Big Lots at the Shoppes at Valley Forge, its first store in Chester County. Walk-in hiring ran through mid-August and the opening is targeted for after Labor Day.

title: Phoenixville Olympian named Penn women's rowing head coach
summary: Tyler Nase, who grew up rowing the Schuylkill in Phoenixville and went on to the Olympics, has been hired to lead the University of Pennsylvania women's rowing program.

title: The Boardroom brings new life to a steel-era building on Bridge Street
summary: The Boardroom Restaurant & Bottle Shop occupies a turn-of-the-century home once used by a local steel superintendent at 101 Bridge Street. Owner Patrick Merriman took over the former Paloma's space and finished renovations earlier this year.

title: Amtrak signs on to Reading-Philadelphia rail plan with a Phoenixville stop
summary: Amtrak and the Schuylkill River Passenger Rail Authority signed an agreement naming Amtrak the proposed operator for restored service between Reading and Philadelphia. Intermediate stops are planned for Phoenixville and Pottstown.
